lines.japanese: 音の源泉を探りあてるのはそう難しくなかった。要するに、この前と同じ場所だったんだ。
lines.english: Tracking down the source of the sound wasn't difficult. It was, in short, the same place as last time.

lines.japanese: 輝ききれない白色灯が照らす、最終電車が去ったあとの鉄道高架下。俺が到着したときには、すでに（文字通りの）黒山の人だかりが築かれていた。
lines.english: Beneath the railway viaduct after the last train had gone, lit by white lamps that never quite managed to shine, a mass of humanity had already formed—black in more than the usual figurative sense.

lines.japanese: 今宵の聴衆は、沈んだ色合いのパンク小僧やゴシック小僧たちで満たされている。革と鋲、薔薇と十字架、黒と銀。なんだかカルト教団のイニシエーションじみてる。いかにも一見さんお断りの雰囲気だ。
lines.english: Tonight’s audience was all punk kids and goth kids in somber colors. Leather and studs, roses and crosses, black and silver. It looked like some cult’s initiation rite. The atmosphere said regulars only.

lines.japanese: 甲高い硬質音が、スプレーだらけのコンクリートに跳ねかえって跳ねかえって、また跳ねかえって広がる。
lines.english: The high, hard notes struck the spray-painted concrete, ricocheted, ricocheted again, and spread.

lines.japanese: 半円状に壁を囲んだＲなんたらの小僧どもは、みな歓声もクラップもなく、ただ口寄せを始めるイタコの婆さんみたいに目を閉じてゆらりゆらりと揺れていた。ガード下の陰気なサタデーナイト・フィーバー。
lines.english: The R-something kids ringed the wall in a semicircle. Not one cheered or clapped. Eyes closed, they merely swayed and swayed like old spirit mediums summoning the dead. A gloomy *Saturday Night Fever* beneath the tracks.

lines.japanese: 俺は黒い背中たちの後ろに貼りついた。街の中ではありきたりなカジュアルファッションも、ここではたちまち浮きあがった。
lines.english: I tucked myself in behind a row of black-clad backs. Casual clothes that would have vanished into any other city crowd made me stand out here at once.

lines.japanese: だから、横にいたお岩さんみたいな女もすぐ俺に振りむいた。背の高い女だ。クソ長い黒髪の奥の、どろりとしたシンナー中毒者みたいな目で俺を見る。
lines.english: Which was why the woman beside me, a long-haired ghost from an old horror play, immediately turned my way. A tall woman. From behind that absurd curtain of black hair, she fixed me with the viscous eyes of a solvent addict.

lines.japanese: そしてそれはひとり、またひとりと続いた。突きささる幾つもの不気味な視線。なるほど、一般の客が寄りつけないわけだ。
lines.english: Then another turned. And another. A forest of eerie stares ran me through. No wonder ordinary customers stayed away.
“Oh. You're...”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「……あは、思いだした。天子が血塗られて誰もみんな執行人として目覚めたあの日、僕たちを嘲笑っていた選民意識の白い眼だ」
lines.english: “...Aha. I remember. Those cold, superior eyes that mocked us on the day the Son of Heaven was drenched in blood and everyone awoke an executioner.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、なんだ、あんときの電波女か」
lines.english: “Oh. You’re that human transmitter from last time.”

lines.japanese: あーあー、今日も相変わらず出してんなあ、ゆんゆんだ。
lines.english: Oh, right. Still broadcasting at full power tonight.

lines.japanese: 「まあ、いいや。それよかさ、なあ、ハリュー・クロードってやつ怪我もう治っ──」
lines.english: “Whatever. More importantly, has that Haryu Claude guy's injury healed alrea—”

lines.japanese: 「しぃーだよ」
lines.english: “Shhh, now.”

lines.japanese: モデルみたいにデカい女は、子供みたいに人差し指を唇へ添えた。他のもの言わぬ目たちも、明らかに沈黙ないし退去を命じている。
lines.english: The woman, tall as a model, put one index finger to her lips like a child. All the other speechless eyes were plainly ordering me either to shut up or leave.

lines.japanese: 「生に固執する清々しいノイズで、どうか僕たちの爛れた耳を塞がないで。これは儀式、痛みと涙と獣の本能を呼びさます儀式。鼓膜じゃなくて心で聴くの、聴くのじゃなくて沁みこませるの」
lines.english: “Please don’t clog our festering ears with the wholesome noise of your clinging to life. This is a rite—a rite to awaken pain and tears and animal instinct. Listen with your heart, not your eardrums. Don’t listen. Let it seep inside you.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ、そーすか」
lines.english: “Uh-huh. Sure thing.”

lines.japanese: よく分からないけど、静かにしてくれっていう意思だけは伝わってきた。結構だ。こっちだってべつに、おまえらと語らいに来たわけじゃない。
lines.english: I didn't understand much, but the part where she wanted me quiet came through. Fine by me. I hadn't come here to commune with them either.

lines.japanese: 「いい子だね」
lines.english: “Good boy.”

lines.japanese: 俺が口を閉ざすと、幽霊女は俺の頭をぽんぽん撫でてから正面に向きなおった。じろじろ俺たちを観察してた他の連中も、それを機にみな音楽鑑賞へ戻る。
lines.english: When I shut my mouth, the ghost woman patted me twice on the head and turned forward again. The rest of them, who'd been staring openly, took that as their cue to return to the music.

lines.japanese: 「ふん」
lines.english: “Hmph.”

lines.japanese: 粘着質な視線が払拭されて清々したところで、俺もあらためて半円の中心を覗きこんだ。
lines.english: Relieved to be rid of those clammy stares, I looked into the center of the semicircle again.

lines.japanese: やつがいた。ハリュー・クロード。落書きだらけの汚い壁を背にして、聴衆に目線ひとつよこすことなくジェンベを叩いていた。その体に目立った外傷は……なさそうだ。
lines.english: There he was. Haryu Claude. Backed by a filthy wall dense with graffiti, he beat the djembe without sparing his listeners so much as a glance. As for visible injuries... there didn't seem to be any.

lines.japanese: 俺は指先をジーンズのポケットに挿し、片足に重心を寄せて演奏に耳を傾けた。この奏者、どうも人格には一癖二癖あるみたいだけど、出す音はやっぱり掛け値なしにカッチョいい。
lines.english: I hooked my fingertips into my jeans pockets, settled my weight on one leg, and listened. The musician clearly had more than his share of quirks, but the sound he made was still, no bullshit, cool as hell.

lines.japanese: 「ン、ッセア！　ン、ッセア！　ほっ！　あ゛あ！」
lines.english: “Nn-seyah! Nn-seyah! Hoh! Aagh!”

lines.japanese: 反対側の最前列に、気合を発しながら体を揺すっているパイナップル頭を見つけた。佐久間だか咲夜だかいうパンク小僧だ。相変わらず他の陰気な連中からは激しく浮きまくっている。
lines.english: In the opposite front row I found Pineapple Head, rocking his body and punctuating the music with martial shouts. The punk kid called Sakuma or Sakuya or something. As usual, he stood out violently among all the other gloomy bastards.

lines.japanese: やつは目蓋をきつく閉じて、自分の世界に入りこんでいる。こちらに気付いていないのは幸いだ。やつが目を開ける前に、俺は立ち位置を調整して、群衆の背中が遮蔽物となるようなポジションを選んだ。
lines.english: His eyes were squeezed shut; he'd gone deep into his own world. Lucky for me, he hadn't noticed I was there. Before he opened them, I shifted until the crowd's backs gave me cover.

lines.japanese: そして内臓まで届く心地よいリズムにしばし浸っているうち、俺は奏者の動きに微妙な違和感を覚えた。
lines.english: As I soaked in the pleasant rhythm pulsing all the way into my guts, I sensed a subtle wrongness in the musician's movements.

lines.japanese: この夜のハリュー・クロードには、あの夜見たような一種呪術的とも言える熱狂さがない。全身振りみだして踊るように叩いていた、あのシャーマニックな高揚感がないんだ。
lines.english: Tonight’s Haryu Claude had none of the almost sorcerous frenzy I’d witnessed that other night. None of that shamanic rapture, dancing as he played and flinging his whole body into every stroke.

lines.japanese: あのときとは曲が違うということなんだろうか。湧きあがる衝動を冷水のような理性で抑えている、そんなプレイスタイルに見えた。
lines.english: Maybe tonight’s piece was simply different. He seemed to be holding a surging impulse in check with reason cold as water.

lines.japanese: 今宵、信奉者たちが神妙な聴き手に徹しているのは、俺以上にその空気を感じとっているせいなのかもしれない。
lines.english: Perhaps his followers were listening in such solemn silence tonight because they sensed that atmosphere more keenly than I did.

lines.japanese: ──しかし、その神妙な聴き手たちにやがて変化が生じた。
lines.english: —Before long, however, a change came over those solemn listeners.

lines.japanese: 「おっと……ようやくお出ましのようだね……」
lines.english: “Oh... It appears they've finally deigned to make an appearance...”

lines.japanese: 半円の向こう側で、陰気なガキ共がある一点を見据えてどよどよと色めきだした。半円のこちら側にいた連中も、仲間たちのその視線を追って振りかえる。
lines.english: Across the semicircle, the gloomy brats fixed their eyes upon a single point and began stirring in dark excitement. The ones on this side followed their companions' gaze and turned.

lines.japanese: なんだ。こっちの後ろに何が来たんだ。釣られて、思わず俺も振りむいてみた。
lines.english: What was it? What had shown up behind us? Caught up in the current, I turned without thinking.
“Ugh.”

lines.japanese: そして次の瞬間には、ほとんど条件反射的のように身を隠していた。
lines.english: By the next instant, I had hidden myself almost on reflex.

lines.japanese: 鉄道高架の向こう、紫色の空の下から、ハゲや坊主やニット帽のだぼついたシルエットがずらり肩を並べて近づいてくる。やたらガニ股のチンピラ歩き。
lines.english: Beyond the railway, beneath the purple sky, a wall of baggy silhouettes approached shoulder to shoulder: bald heads, buzz cuts, knit caps. They came on bowlegged, all cheap-thug swagger.

lines.japanese: 「イェア、今日はロスに似た懐かしい風が吹いてるぜ。Ｈｕｈ、この街ギバラも捨てたもんじゃねえな」
lines.english: “Yeah. Got a nostalgic wind blowing today, just like back in Los. Huh. This town of Gibara ain't half bad.”

lines.japanese: 「ぶはー！　おもっそくなってきたあ、もう俺いっちゃうよ～！　つってスパー！　さらにスパー！」
lines.english: “Bwah! Now this is gettin’ fun! I’m about to lose it—puff! And another puff!”

lines.japanese: 「つか、マジちょっと、タルくなってきちったよー。ねー、これソッコー片付けてラーメンとか良くな～い？　良くなくな～い？」
lines.english: “I mean, seriously, this is kinda starting to drag. Hey, can’t we mop this up quick and go get ramen? Wouldn’t that be good? I mean, wouldn’t it?”

lines.japanese: 陽気な敵の陽気な行進を前にして、陰気な小僧どもは陰気な闘志を燃やす。示しあわせたかのように、両軍とも同程度の人数だった。
lines.english: The gloomy kids met the cheerful enemy’s cheerful march with gloomy fighting spirit. As though by arrangement, the two sides were almost exactly matched in numbers.

lines.japanese: 「ふン……数にものを言わせて物量で押してくるかと思えば、小癪なニワトリめ、この期に及んで出し惜しみか？」
lines.english: “Hmph... I expected the Chicken to throw his numbers around and crush us by sheer weight. Yet the impudent creature grows miserly even at this late hour?”

lines.japanese: 「いやあ、賢明ですよ。きっと彼らは自覚してるんでしょう、これが負け戦だってね」
lines.english: “Oh, no, it's quite sensible. Surely they know already that they've come to lose.”

lines.japanese: 「どことなく不自然な道化の化粧を落としてあげよう。わずかな現実とも向きあいたくないから彼らは必死で終わらないパーティーの子供を続けているの。うふふ、僕らが玉手箱をこじ開けて立派な社会へ返してあげる」
lines.english: “Let us wash away that unnatural clown paint. They're children desperately keeping the party going forever because they can't bear to face even a scrap of reality. Heh-heh. We'll pry open their fairy-tale casket and let all those stolen years catch up with them, then send them back to proper society as fine grown-ups.”

lines.japanese: 緊張感とも高揚感とも呼べる重い空気が、もとはただのファン・コミュニティだった集団を、力の衝動に酔わせている──
lines.english: A heavy atmosphere—tension and exhilaration in equal measure—was intoxicating a group once no more than a fan community with the urge to violence—

lines.japanese: ──いまだ一拍の躊躇もなくアフリカ太鼓を叩きつづける男は、こんな状況をどう思っているんだろう。
lines.english: —and what did the man who kept beating his African drum without a single beat of hesitation make of all this?

lines.japanese: 「じゃっ、じゃぁ～ん！」
lines.english: “Ta-daaa!”

lines.japanese: 大型トラック一台分ぐらいの距離を置いて、ニワトリ軍団は歩みを止めた。センターに控える茶髪の童顔は、さながらバックダンサーを従える売れっ子アイドルみたいだった。
lines.english: The Chicken Army stopped roughly one tractor-trailer's length away. The baby-faced boy with brown hair standing center stage looked like a pop idol flanked by backup dancers.

lines.japanese: 「炎のガーディアン、柳木原フレイムバーズ参上！　そりゃっ、フェニックスのポーズ！」
lines.english: “The guardians of flame—the Yanagihara Flame Birds have arrived! Now! Phoenix pose!”

lines.japanese: 森里が片足立ちで両手をＹの字に広げた。面倒は御免だ。俺はアホがアホをやってるうちに後ろへ後ろへと下がり、間違っても馴れ馴れしく名前を呼ばれたりしないよう姿を隠した。
lines.english: Morisato balanced on one foot and spread his arms in a Y. I wanted no trouble. While the idiots were busy performing idiocy, I edged farther and farther back, hiding so there was no chance of anyone calling my name like we were old friends.

lines.japanese: ハリュー・クロードのジェンベはなお激しく鳴りつづけている。あいつもあいつで、そうやって自分の無関係さを誇示しているのかもしれない。気持ちは分かる。俺はほんのり親近感を覚えた。
lines.english: Haryu Claude's djembe still thundered on. Maybe that was his way of loudly declaring that none of this had anything to do with him. I knew the feeling. A faint sense of kinship stirred in me.

lines.japanese: 「正義とな？　笑わせるわ、偽善すら貫けぬ血に飢えた蛮族が」
lines.english: “Justice, you say? Don't make me laugh, you blood-hungry barbarians who cannot sustain even your own hypocrisy.”

lines.japanese: 性同一性障害のシャンソン歌手みたいなナリをした女装の男が、黒い群れの中から歩みでて半円の中ほどに立った。
lines.english: A cross-dressed man styled like a trans chanson singer out of some dated television act stepped from the black-clad crowd and took his place near the center of the semicircle.

lines.japanese: 出鱈目に極彩色を散りばめた頭が、アマゾンに棲まうオウムを思わせる。不健康そうな白い顔は、わざわざファンデーションかドーランでも塗ってるみたいだった。
lines.english: A head splashed at random with every lurid color brought to mind a parrot of the Amazon. His unhealthy white face looked deliberately painted with foundation or greasepaint.

lines.japanese: 睨みあう両軍。その対峙に呼応したのか、たまたまそういう曲だったのか──やむことのないジェンベがここに来て一段テンポを上げた。
lines.english: The two armies glared at each other. Whether in answer to the confrontation or merely because that was how the piece went, the unceasing djembe now climbed another notch in tempo.

lines.japanese: からここ、からここ、こんここん！　からここ、からここ、こんここん！
lines.english: Tak-a-tak, tak-a-tak, ka-tak-a-tak! Tak-a-tak, tak-a-tak, ka-tak-a-tak!

lines.japanese: 「我らが主の聖痕にかけて、赦されざる咎に裁きを！　紅き涙をもって朱き血を漱がん！」
lines.english: “By the stigmata of our Lord, judgment upon the unforgivable transgression! With crimson tears shall scarlet blood be cleansed!”

lines.japanese: オウム頭がファンタジー映画のまじないじみた口上を唱えると、太鼓の音をかき消さんばかりの狂信的な喚声が轟いた。
lines.english: When Parrot Head finished chanting his fantasy-movie incantation, a fanatical roar thundered out, nearly drowning the drum.

lines.japanese: 「うるへえぇぇぇ──っ！　うるへー、ばーか！　死ね！　×んこ噛んで死ね！」
lines.english: “Shut the heeeell up! Shut up, morons! Die! Bite a d×ck and die!”

lines.japanese: 対する“正義の味方”たちは、敬虔なる信徒たちの怒りを笑い、嘲り、罵った。
lines.english: The opposing “champions of justice” answered the devout believers’ fury with laughter, jeers, and abuse.

lines.japanese: 「おめえら辛気くっせーんだよ、ぷぁーッといこうぜ、ぷぁーっと！」
lines.english: “You assholes are too goddamn gloomy! Let's cut loose! C'mon, live it up!”

lines.japanese: 「大輔、いっちょかましたれ」
lines.english: “Daisuke, let 'em have one.”

lines.japanese: 「おぃーっす、任されたぁー！」
lines.english: “Yo! Leave it to me!”

lines.japanese: 森里が肩越しに仲間へ指示を出し、正面に人差し指を突きだした。ド派手なギャル男風のガキが頷いて、走者を背負ってないピッチャーのように悠然と振りかぶる。
lines.english: Morisato thrust an index finger straight ahead as he gave the order over his shoulder. A gaudily dressed club kid nodded, then took a leisurely windup like a pitcher with nobody on base.

lines.japanese: 「炸裂！　ファイア・フラッシュ！」
lines.english: “Detonate! Fire Flash!”

lines.japanese: ギャル男の手から何かが飛んだ。次の瞬間──
lines.english: Something flew from the club kid's hand. The next instant—

lines.japanese: ──深夜のガード下、対峙する両軍のちょうど中間距離あたりで、耳を聾する爆音とチープな白光が長らく連続して弾けた。
lines.english: —midway between the two armies facing off beneath the tracks at midnight, deafening reports and cheap white flashes erupted one after another for what felt like forever.

lines.japanese: 「ひいいっ！」
lines.english: “Eeeeeek!”

lines.japanese: 「な、なな、なんだあ！？」
lines.english: “Wh-wh-wh-what is that!?”

lines.japanese: 俺は身を低くして黒い群集に隠れながら、両手で耳を塞いだ。何だも何も、こんなん鼻タレ小学生でも買えるただの爆竹だ。やつらはクソ真面目なＲなんたらを挑発してるんだ。
lines.english: Keeping low in the black crowd, I covered both ears. What was it? Ordinary firecrackers, that’s what—any snot-nosed grade-schooler could buy them. The bastards were provoking the deadly serious R-whatevers.

lines.japanese: 「ぎゃはは！　見てみアレ、ゴキブリがきゃんきゃん跳ねまわってんよ！」
lines.english: “Bwahaha! Look at 'em! Cockroaches yelping and jumping all over the place!”

lines.japanese: 「ぷっくく……あっ、あの顔っ……ひ、ひひっ、やっべ超ウケる、あいつら超ビビリだよ～」
lines.english: “Pff—ha ha... Th-that face... H-heehee, oh man, I’m dying. They’re scared shitless!”

lines.japanese: 「つうかアレだ、ガラスのハートだ」
lines.english: “I mean, that's it. Hearts of glass.”

lines.japanese: 「お、おのれ下衆な豚共め、聖なる戦をどこまで愚弄すれば気が済むか……Ｒ１突撃！　やつらを捕らえ八つ裂きにせよ！」
lines.english: “Y-you vile swine! How long will you continue to profane this sacred war...? R1, charge! Seize them and tear them limb from limb!”

lines.japanese: ロボットアニメの司令官みたいな芝居くさい声が響きわたった。それを受けて黒装束の最前列が、けたたましい火薬の炸裂音にも負けない喚声をあげて飛びだしてゆく。
lines.english: The theatrical voice rang out like a commander in a giant-robot anime. At the order, the front rank in black surged forward with a roar that rivaled the shrill crack of gunpowder.

lines.japanese: 「え、えええ……？」
lines.english: “W-whaaat...?”

lines.japanese: 俺はあまりにも現実離れした光景に唖然としていた。どこのミュージカルシアターに迷いこんでしまったんだろう。なにもんだ、こいつら。
lines.english: I stared, stupefied by a spectacle too divorced from reality. What musical had I wandered into? What the hell were these people?

lines.japanese: 「赦さない、赦さないよおまえら！」
lines.english: “I won't forgive you! I will never forgive you!”

lines.japanese: 「おいおい来たぜ来たぜぇ！　いいねえ坊ちゃんたち、勇敢だねえ、うぇっへっへ！」
lines.english: “Oh, here they come, here they come! That's it, boys! So brave! Wah-ha-ha!”

lines.japanese: 「ンニャアアアーッ！　てめぇぇるぁぁぁ！　ぶぶぶぶっこるぉぉぉす！」
lines.english: “GRAAAAAH! YOU BAAAASTARDS! I'LL K-K-K-KIIIIIILL YOU!”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　なんだ、あのイカれたねーちゃんは。日本語言えてねーじゃん。アンパン喰いすぎて、脳細胞十億ぐれー溶けちゃってんじゃねえの」
lines.english: “Huh? What's with that psycho chick? Can't even speak Japanese. Been huffing so much thinner she's melted a billion brain cells or some shit.”

lines.japanese: 怒りをあらわにして走るＲ－ウィング。迎えるフレイムバーズの顔には余裕の笑みがあった。
lines.english: R-Wing charged with their fury on full display. The Flame Birds waiting for them wore easy smiles.

lines.japanese: 「かかか、よしチケドンさん、アレ貸してアレ」
lines.english: “Ha-ha-ha. All right, Chikedon, lemme borrow that thing.”

lines.japanese: 「ほいきた！」
lines.english: “You got it!”

lines.japanese: 森里に言われたレゲエ風は、ピンフ通りのどこかから拝借してきたんだろう、風俗店のアルミ看板を後ろから引きずりだしてきた。
lines.english: At Morisato’s word, the reggae-looking guy dragged out an aluminum sign for an adult club, presumably “borrowed” from somewhere on Pinfu Street.

lines.japanese: 「おっしゃ、喰らえ！　必殺！　フライング・フードル！」
lines.english: “All right, eat this! Finishing move—Flying Adult Idol!”

lines.japanese: やつは両手でそれをフリスビー投げした。
lines.english: He hurled it two-handed like a Frisbee.

lines.japanese: 「ちっ！」
lines.english: “Tch!”

lines.japanese: ひるんだＲ－ウィングの突撃隊が左右に散ってかわす。カメラ目線な半裸のねーちゃんが、ドでかい音を響かせて放置自転車に突きささった。
lines.english: The startled R-Wing shock troops scattered left and right. The half-naked woman pictured on the sign sailed into an abandoned bicycle with an enormous clang.

lines.japanese: 「あっはーん！」
lines.english: “Ooh, baby!”

lines.japanese: 森里はねーちゃんのポーズを真似して、後頭部と股間にそれぞれ手を当てた。真っ赤なポップ体は『ヌかせてみせます花びら三回転』。
lines.english: Morisato copied the woman’s pose, one hand behind his head and the other over his crotch. In bold red display lettering: *We’ll Get You Off—Triple-Petal Spin.*

lines.japanese: 役目を終えた爆竹の白い煙が、ゆるい風に乗りきれずその場に停滞していた。Ｒ－ウィングの一番槍はその白煙を突きやぶり、半裸の女を踏みこえてふたたび迫撃する。
lines.english: The white smoke from the spent firecrackers failed to catch the feeble breeze and pooled where it was. R-Wing's vanguard burst through it, trampled over the half-naked woman, and charged again.

lines.japanese: 「にぎゃああああああ！　くくくくたばりゃああああ！」
lines.english: “GRAAAAAAAH! D-d-d-dieeeee!”

lines.japanese: 「ヘェ──ッヘッヘッ！　来いよ、来いよオラァ！」
lines.english: “Heeey-heh-heh! Come on! Come get me!”

lines.japanese: 森里たちは挑発しながらバックステップで数歩ずつ下がってゆく。やがてある程度まで距離を詰められると、ついにくるりと背を向け全速力で駆けだした。
lines.english: Still jeering, Morisato and his crew backpedaled several steps at a time. Once they'd let the gap close far enough, they finally wheeled around and sprinted flat out.

lines.japanese: 「ぶぶぶぶ豚クソがァァァ！　待てコルァァァ！」
lines.english: “Y-y-you pigshit bastards! Get back heeere!”

lines.japanese: 「ハッハー！　来いやゴキブリ軍団！」
lines.english: “Ha-ha! Come on, cockroach army!”

lines.japanese: 「イェー！　ＹＦＢイェー！」
lines.english: “Yeah! YFB, yeah!”

lines.japanese: 「くっ……猊下、豚が二手に分かれました！　我らに適切なるご指示を！」
lines.english: “Damn... Your Holiness, the swine have split in two! Give us our orders!”

lines.japanese: 「Ｒ１は左、Ｒ２は右を追え！　クルセイダースはこの場に待機、前後を警戒せよ！　Ｒ３は付近を哨戒し伏兵を探せ！　これは聖戦である、赦されざる咎に血の裁きを！」
lines.english: “R1, pursue left! R2, pursue right! Crusaders, hold this ground and watch your front and rear! R3, patrol the perimeter and search for ambushes! This is a holy war—blood judgment upon the unforgivable sin!”

lines.japanese: 「赦されざる咎に裁きを！」
lines.english: “Judgment upon the unforgivable sin!”

lines.japanese: オウム頭の女装男は、稽古でもしてあったのか、てきぱきと指令を飛ばした。その命を受けて、ハリュー・クロードを囲んでいた黒い半円は、水流で剥がれおちる油汚れのようにはらはらと崩れていった。
lines.english: Parrot Head snapped out his orders with brisk precision, as though they'd rehearsed this. At his command, the black semicircle around Haryu Claude broke apart and peeled away like greasy dirt under running water.

lines.japanese: 台風一過。しかしガード下のライブハウスには、何事もなかったかのように平然とアフリカ太鼓の音色が響いていた。そして俺は、ただ言葉もなく冷たい壁に身を寄せ──
lines.english: The storm had passed. Yet in the makeshift venue beneath the tracks, the African drum rang on with perfect composure, as though nothing at all had happened. And I stood pressed wordlessly against the cold wall—

lines.japanese: ──ぽかーんとしていた。
lines.english: —mouth hanging open.

lines.japanese: なにもんだこいつら。
lines.english: What the hell were these people?
